reviews.decision: Complete untouched16 and both advertised minimum declaration entries/targets authenticate this stable public literal alias and its full public export chain. No selected declaration/export has deprecated, docs-private, experimental or breaking-change markers. The complete alias body is self-contained and its literal/void domain exactly matches untouched16: 'left' | 'right' | 'above' | 'below' | 'before' | 'after'. Strict diagnostics cover every accepted literal, invalid/null/number/boolean/array domains, forward/backward assignments and exact equality. The selected named binding appears only in authenticated type references or in an original-named public reexport; no value/reference context is admitted. Every selected source file emits byte-identical executable JavaScript after removing just these type bindings, with reflection metadata disabled. Twenty-three wrong-domain, forged source/model, runtime/generic use and changed public alias/module controls fail; an import alias preserves the same emitted program. This closes only this finite type/erasure boundary. Full component/barrel compilation, Angular reflection/factory metadata, accessibility or event/render behavior and native/packed/runtime/compiler floors remain separate. All product and consumer resources are unchanged; no upstream SHA or whole G11 closure is inferred. The one independently qualified clipping callback/predicate repair now uses public pane/ancestor DOMRects before position-class changes. All imports/exported signatures,hide/class methods and33 resources remain unchanged. This current binding retains the original role conclusion and complete prior case,with fresh checker-bound uses and current class contexts; no whole directive,native,packed/AOT or floor pass is inferred. Independent current source comparison retains the exact named type contexts; TooltipVisibility has no reference. Untouched tag and installed 22.1.7 declaration unions match. Full source transition records changed animation injection and overlay event predicate, which remain behaviorally unqualified.
